pages.title: An Ominous Buffet
pages.text: Put a straw hat on a frog and it will start swallowing raiders by itself; once it has eaten enough different kinds of raider, the hat falls off and the change completes.$(br2)How it is counted$(br2)Each distinct raider type the frog swallows counts once, and the tally belongs to the frog rather than to the hat, so a second frog means starting over. Only one frog can wear the straw hat at a time, and a frog without it will not touch raiders at all.
While worn$(br2)The hat grants Native God's Bless — it raises your movement speed and your reach, and adds 25% magic damage on top of everything else you are wearing.
